# coordinate frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coordinateFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a set of coordinates to the reference frame they are expressed in.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) -> [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) from [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) to [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md), [`gmeow:SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md), [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the single frame a [`SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) value is expressed in; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it (the frame gate warns) and avoid using it outside [`SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md).

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) per [`SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md); for celestial points use it on [`CelestialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-CelestialCoordinates.md) too.

### Examples

- ex:pos [`gmeow:coordinateFrame`](gmeow-coordinateFrame.md) [`gmeow:referenceFrameWGS84`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameWGS84.md).
